verdict.rationale: Recurly docs confirm a data export feature covering customer records, subscriptions, invoices, coupons, transactions, and revenue recognition, showing some data portability, but there is no mention of specific open/standard file formats (CSV/JSON), no full account-data export (e.g., historical logs, entitlements, payment methods) coverage confirmed, and no documentation addressing a clean 'leave' or account-closure workflow. missing for 10: explicit open-format specification, full-account export completeness, and offboarding/exit process documentation.
